prompt:
Aster turn text is capped at 20,000 characters, with a 64 KiB request body limit and a 32 KiB cell-bridge limit, so pasted documents are rejected with `invalid_turn`. Raise the limits to 500,000 characters, 4 MiB request bodies, and 8 MiB for the cell bridge (`src/server/aster-api.ts`, `src/sdk/aster-cell.ts`), and make the subagent policy's prompt-length handling in `src/intent/subagent-policy.ts` cope with such long prompts. A ~100k-character turn must be accepted.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/intent/subagent-policy.test.ts`, `src/server/aster-api.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/intent/subagent-policy.test.ts src/server/aster-api.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
